title: Residual physics research claims — Lean qualification ledger

policy.proof_standard: A claim is verified only when its exact statement compiles in the pinned Lean environment and is included in the audited root; numerical evidence alone is not a Lean proof.
policy.no_placeholders: Do not mark a task verified from an assumed result, an unexecuted numerical calculation, sorry/admit, or an axiom added for the target claim.

tasks.label: Numerical FRG confirmation
needed: Pin the flow equation, regulator, truncation, boundary conditions, and parameter conventions.
Provide reproducible numerical solution data with convergence and precision checks.
Formalize only exact mathematical statements derivable from the specification; keep floating-point results as externally checked evidence unless their error bounds are proved.
tasks.acceptance: A reproducible numerical artifact plus at least one nontrivial theorem about the specified discretization or certified bounds, compiled in Lean.

tasks.label: Lattice Page-curve evaluation
needed: Pin the lattice model, state preparation, subsystem partition, entropy definition, and finite-size conventions.
Supply independently reproducible entropy data and finite-size/error analysis.
Encode exact finite-dimensional identities and any proven bounds in Lean without asserting a continuum limit absent a proof.
tasks.acceptance: Exact finite-lattice theorem(s) compile in Lean and numerical results carry reproducible inputs and uncertainty analysis.

tasks.label: Standard-Model-shifted fixed-point coordinates
needed: Pin beta functions, scheme, truncation, Standard Model parameter inputs, and coordinate normalization.
Reproduce the fixed-point solve and Jacobian/stability calculation independently.
Formalize algebraic identities or certified interval claims for the specified system.
tasks.acceptance: Pinned equations and inputs, reproduced coordinates with uncertainty/stability checks, and compiled Lean theorems for exact or interval-certified claims.

tasks.label: Cosmological MCMC
needed: Pin likelihoods, priors, datasets/releases, nuisance parameters, sampler, seed policy, and convergence criteria.
Reproduce chains and diagnostics; do not treat sampled posterior estimates as deductive proofs.
Use Lean for exact likelihood/prior identities or proved sampler invariants where appropriate.
tasks.acceptance: Reproducible chain artifacts and diagnostics plus clearly scoped Lean proofs of exact mathematical properties; posterior summaries remain empirical.

current_repo_scan.result: No task-specific formalization has been confirmed by this ledger commit. Existing formal package qualification is used to verify the current Lean project and theorem audit; this is not evidence that the four research claims themselves are proved.
current_repo_scan.next_step: Inspect runner logs, then add task-specific definitions and theorems only after source equations, numerical artifacts, and assumptions are pinned.
